candidates.change_summary: Change the return value to always return false instead of true.
Return the success flag of the last external call instead of always true.
Return true only if the loop runs at least once; if _tos empty (though require prevents it) return false — changes observable return if require removed externally via try-call scenarios.
Change the function to use call with a zero value by replacing caddress.call with a low-level staticcall, preventing state changes in the callee and thus altering transfer observable effects.
Change the function to forward Ether value v (as wei) with each call by using caddress.call{value: v}(...), which can alter external observable behavior when transfer involves value transfers.
Negate the require on _tos.length to require it equals zero, causing different reachable behaviors and likely reverting for non-empty arrays.
Change the loop to iterate from 1 to _tos.length (skipping index 0), altering which addresses are called and thus external observable behavior.
